integrity: The sharp three-switch witness has rigorous rational exponential enclosures; the upper bound and minimum-source requirement follow from exact Bayes reduction and elementary exponential Chebyshev theory. The general zero-count mechanism is prior work and not asserted new.
scientific_limitations: Idealized independent Bernoulli occupancy and additive conditional-Poisson count; known background, no correlated emissions, no stochastic measurement errors, not empirically fitted or independently externally audited.
title: Three-source Poisson attribution permits exactly three posterior ranking reversals
